shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'components/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.json' -g 'README*' -g '*config*' -g 'public/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat tsconfig.json && ls node_modules/@playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium || which chromium-browser || true'
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"try {console.log(require.resolve('playwright'))} catch(e) {console.log('no playwright')}\" && git diff --stat && cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package=@playwright/test -- playwright --version'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la /tmp && ls -d /root/.cache/ms-playwright/* /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/* 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc "ls /usr/bin | rg 'chrom|firefox|browser' ; ls /opt ; ls node_modules | rg 'play|pupp|jsdom|happy'; git status --short; printenv | rg -i 'npm|proxy'"
/bin/bash -lc "curl -I --max-time 10 https://registry.npmjs.org/@playwright/test && ls node_modules | rg 'prettier|eslint|format'"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls /home/node/.npm/_npx 2>/dev/null; cat .gitignore'
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la /home/node/.npm/_npx/420ff84f11983ee5 && ls node_modules | rg 'prettier|eslint|format'"
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"fetch('https://registry.npmjs.org/@playwright/test', {signal:AbortSignal.timeout(10000)}).then(r=>console.log(r.status)).catch(e=>console.log(e.message))\""
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la /home/node/.npm/_npx/420ff84f11983ee5/node_modules; ls /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages 2>/dev/null | head'
/bin/bash -lc 'node /home/node/.npm/_npx/420ff84f11983ee5/node_modules/playwright/cli.js install chromium'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); let s=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8');s=s.replace('lang=\\\"en\\\"','lang=\\\"ru\\\"').replace('Gravity UI eval','Контур — управление заказами');fs.writeFileSync('index.html',s);\""
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'max-width: 980|topbar|setCollapsed|hint-right' src/styles.css src/App.tsx | tail -15 && sed -n '1670,1780p' src/styles.css"
/bin/bash -lc "which apt-get; which sudo; id; sed -n '317,329p' src/App.tsx; ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu | head"
/bin/bash -lc "ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found'; ls /var/lib/apt/lists | head; ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libglib*"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/browser-libs && cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libthai0 libdatrie1 libharfbuzz0b libgraphite2-3'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'settingsSaved|Настройки сохранены|defaultValue=\"Studio|defaultValue=\"Алекс|defaultValue=\"alex|Валюта|Российский|Доллар|Евро|Алексей Соколов|Studio Store' src/App.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in /tmp/browser-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$f" /tmp/browser-libs/root; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg '"'not found'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download libavahi-common3 libavahi-client3 libwayland-server0 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libxrender1 libfribidi0 libxi6 fonts-dejavu-core'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1260,1332p' src/App.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/browser-libs && apt-get download libsqlite3-0 fontconfig-config && for f in /tmp/browser-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$f" /tmp/browser-libs/root; done
mkdir -p /home/node/.config/fontconfig
cat > /home/node/.config/fontconfig/fonts.conf <<'"'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?>
<"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd">
<fontconfig><dir>/tmp/browser-libs/root/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/fontconfig-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module - <<'NODE'
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';const prettier=await import('/tmp/prettier-standalone.mjs');const plugins=await Promise.all(['postcss'].map(n=>import('/tmp/prettier-'+n+'.mjs')));await fs.writeFile('src/styles.css',await prettier.format(await fs.readFile('src/styles.css','utf8'),{parser:'css',plugins,printWidth:100,singleQuote:true}));
NODE
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat'
